title: Analytical Validation of Multimodal AI Test Predicting Breast Cancer Recurrence Risk (Ataraxis Breast RISK).
summary: A locked H&E-image and clinical-data AI test passed prespecified repeatability and reproducibility checks in 160 breast-cancer cases, including 94.7% agreement across two laboratories/scanners. This is analytical readiness evidence, not independent clinical utility evidence.
ai_technology: Kestrel vision-transformer patch embeddings are attention-aggregated, combined with clinical variables, and scored by an ensemble of Cox neural networks with calibration.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.unknown: Prespecified analytical acceptance criteria were assessed using repeat runs, two operators, two labs/scanners, controls, perturbed covariates and a clinical-validation bridge; cohort was retrospective and largely ER-positive/HER2-negative, limiting generalization.
